newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ebara, Dow Chemical unit plan environmental tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Ebara, Dow Chemical unit plan environmental tie-up.

text.p: Ebara Corp said on Tuesday that it has agreed with Radian International LLC, an environmental-business unit of Dow Chemical Co, to conduct joint feasibility studies into developing and operating "zero emission" factories in Southeast Asia.
The studies will look at ways of eliminating waste and the need to dispose of water from the factories, the companies said in a joint statement.
Ebara is one of the world's largest makers of pumps and air blowers used in the disposal of industrial waste.
The tie-up could develop into a joint business enterprise, an Ebara spokesman said. However, he added that there were no concrete plans at the moment.
The statement said the partnership would focus on the Asia-Pacific region in view of the area's emerging economies.
